rules: Never omit source pages or source activities.
Never silently alter source-derived wording; preserve exact extracted text in SOURCE_DERIVED.
Generated explanations/questions must be marked GENERATED and must link to source pages.
Teacher notes/instructions are preserved as source content where present.
Illustrations/visual puzzles that cannot be represented fully as text are flagged by page number rather than fabricated.
Every chapter must contain all six pillars and an internal traceability index.
